scope: Complete quasi-elliptic K3 fibrations and elliptic angle ranks over F_2

common.equation: y^2 = x^3 + A(u)*x + B(u), u=s/t; infinity is t=0
common.key_namespace: Quasi-elliptic table and record keys are package keys in edgarcosta/census_elliptic_fibrations
common.elliptic_key_namespace: The existing census.csv uses collaborator keys; it is unchanged

quasi_csv.shared_fields: The first 18 columns follow data/census.manifest.json in order and encoding, subject to the exceptions below
quasi_csv.blank_meaning: Not applicable: the generic fibre is quasi-elliptic
quasi_csv.fibres: degree:conductor:tamagawa:Kodaira:place, separated by semicolons; conductor is empty
quasi_csv.place: Monic polynomial in u over F_2, without spaces; infinity is the literal infinity
quasi_csv.conductor: No elliptic conductor or discriminant valuation is assigned
quasi_csv.geometric_mw_torsion: Geometric finite section group, trivial or Z/2 x ... x Z/2
quasi_csv.ns_discriminant: Signed discriminant of NS over F_2
quasi_csv.brauer_order: Order of the arithmetic Brauer group over F_2
quasi_csv.product_cv: Product of c_v over closed reducible places once, without degree exponents
quasi_csv.c_v: Number of residue-field points of the component group of the Neron model of the generic smooth locus

fields.key: Package key as a decimal string
fields.equation: Explicit package equation over F_2(u), in the chart u=s/t
fields.A: Coefficients of A(u) in F_2, constant term first
fields.B: Coefficients of B(u) in F_2, constant term first
fields.section_bound: Bound on intersection of a section with the zero section used for exhaustive enumeration
fields.fibres: Closed reducible fibre records; see fibre_fields
fields.geometric_sections: Number of geometric sections, including zero
fields.rational_sections: Number of sections over F_2(u), including zero
fields.quotient_dimension: Dimension of the radical section-coordinate algebra over F_2; counts geometric sections
fields.groebner_basis: Radical section-ideal Groebner basis in c0,c1,... over F_2
fields.rational_points: Nonzero rational sections as [x(u),y(u)] strings; the zero section is omitted
fields.configuration: Geometric root types and their multiplicities
fields.trivial_lattice: Hyperbolic plane, geometric root lattices, rank and signed discriminant
fields.br_disc: Brauer order times absolute NS discriminant over F_2
fields.artin_height: Formal Brauer height, the string infinity
fields.zeta_sign: Leading coefficient of P2 divided by 2^22
fields.frobenius_cycles: Global component cycles, including the fibre and zero-section classes
fields.P2: Degree-22 numerator factor of the surface zeta denominator
fields.ns_characteristic_polynomial: det(X-Frob) on NS without Tate scaling
fields.point_counts: Surface point counts over F_(2^n), n=1,...,5
fields.section_group: Invariant factors of the finite rational section group; empty means trivial
fields.geometric_section_group: Invariant factors of the finite geometric section group
fields.section_smith_factors: Smith factors over F_2[z] of the additive section equations
fields.section_count_includes_zero: True: section counts include the zero section
fields.direct_point_counts: For n=1,...,5: count, raw weierstrass_count, resolution_correction and blowup_centres
fields.rational_enumeration_candidates: Number of rational candidates in the exhaustive search
fields.method: Saved source program references for local, sections, point_counts and ns calculations
fields.checks: Saved boolean checks named by the property checked
fields.upstream: Saved crosswalk: upstream_line, upstream_key, package key, kind, minimality and invariants_agree
fields.chart: Affine coordinate u=s/t and infinity t=0
fields.product_cv: Product over closed reducible places once, without degree exponents

fibre_fields.place: Monic polynomial in u, or infinity
fibre_fields.cycles: Root-component Frobenius cycle lengths over the residue field
fibre_fields.disc_exponent: Exponent of 2 in the geometric root-lattice discriminant; not a Weierstrass discriminant valuation
fibre_fields.multiplicity: Multiplicity of this place in A*(A derivative)^2+(B derivative)^2, homogenized to degree 20
fibre_fields.root_frobenius_orbits: Orbits on zero-based simple-root indices; central vertex followed by the arms
fibre_fields.place_coefficients: Constant-term-first coefficients over F_2; [] means infinity
fibre_fields.c_v: Residue-field points of the component group of the Neron model of the generic smooth locus

quasi_key_map.row_order: line number in data/quasi-elliptic.txt, starting at 1
quasi_key_map.collaborator_line: One-based line in the unchanged data/quasi-elliptic.txt
quasi_key_map.collaborator_key: Key decoded by FibrationFromKeyF2 in this repository
quasi_key_map.package_key: Key in the quasi-elliptic CSV and JSONL; blank for excluded candidates
quasi_key_map.exclusion_reason: Blank for included candidates; reason for exclusion otherwise

angle_ranks.row_order: increasing coefficient count, then integer coefficient tuple
angle_ranks.L_function: Exact bytes of the L_function cell in census.csv; space-separated integer coefficients, constant term first
angle_ranks.angle_rank: Rank modulo roots of unity of the group generated by normalized Frobenius eigenvalues
angle_ranks.multiplicity: Number of elliptic census rows with this L_function
angle_ranks.quasi_elliptic: Excluded from this table; their angle rank is zero

provenance.packaging: Filtered to F_2; joined saved c_v by key and place; translated homogeneous places to u; joined angle ranks by polynomial
provenance.source_programs: Method filenames in JSONL refer to the saved quasi-elliptic calculation, not files in this release

saved_arithmetic_checks: Quasi-elliptic direct point counts over the first five extensions agree for all 680 F_2 surfaces.
Independent equation and section checks cover 60 F_2 surfaces.
Independent Tamagawa equation checks cover 137 fibres from 50 F_2 surfaces and all 54 observed type/degree/cycle triples.
Independent angle ranks agree on 9458 polynomials, including all ranks zero and ten; 275 were repeated at 1000 digits.

limitations: This export packages saved arithmetic; it does not repeat the full calculations.
Independent equation and section checks cover samples, not every quasi-elliptic surface.
The crosswalk identifies equivalent fibrations; it does not transform fibre places or section coordinates to collaborator equations.
